svg.title: HYDRA-UMC-ANDROID-CONTROL architecture
svg.desc: HYDRA-UMC-ANDROID-CONTROL scans the local network for a HYDRA-UMC-SERVER, signs in with a token kept in the Android Keystore, sends small atomic commands over REST and listens to the state over a WebSocket, with Bluetooth LE as a second transport that no device answers yet.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A phone console that finds the server, keeps its credential encrypted, and puts one STOP on every screen.

svg.text: Unit-tested on a plain JVM; the Wi-Fi path was tried against a local server, Bluetooth LE and TLS against a real HYDRA-UMC server were not.
